posts.title: Google Maps in China: why the map is shifted (GCJ-02) and which apps to use instead (2026)
posts.description: Why maps of China are deliberately shifted (GCJ-02, about 600 m in Shenzhen), what goes wrong beyond satellite view (GPS tracks, shared pins, the Hong Kong border) and why Amap or Apple Maps work better than Google Maps.

posts.title: Hospitals in Shenzhen for foreigners: emergencies, international clinics and pharmacies (2026)
posts.description: Where foreigners can see a doctor in Shenzhen: what to do in an emergency, how Chinese hospitals work, international departments with English-speaking staff and direct billing, private hospitals, pharmacies and insurance tips.

posts.title: Where to eat in Shenzhen: Cantonese restaurants, dim sum chains and Meituan tips (2026)
posts.description: How to find good restaurants in Shenzhen with Meituan and Dianping, long-running Cantonese restaurants and dim sum chains like Sheng Ji, Fan Lou and Shun De Lao, and what to expect at each price level.
